in_marathi.name: Rajkummar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of kings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajkummar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj means king and Kumar means prince or young king. The name Rajkummar is derived from Sanskrit and Hindu mythology, and represents the power and authority of a king. This name is perfect for a child born into a royal family or for one who is destined to lead and rule.
